description: Input features for one claim-publisher pair. Values are supplied by upstream extractors that are NOT part of this package. Every feature must be present; use a sentinel rather than omitting it.

sentinels.UNKNOWN: The extractor ran but could not determine the value (e.g. entity not in the knowledge base).
sentinels.NOT_COMPUTED: No extractor exists or it was not run for this pair. Never replaced by a guessed value.

action_type.populated_by: claim-type classifier (not built; needs labelled training claims)

claim_scope.populated_by: location code plus place names (not built)

claim_topic.levels_note: Topic taxonomy is an unresolved decision. Until frozen, any UPPER_SNAKE_CASE token is accepted and a validation warning is raised.
claim_topic.populated_by: topic classifier over a frozen taxonomy (not built)

publisher_type.populated_by: knowledge-base 'instance of' plus a type map frozen before labelling (map not written)

actor_relation.populated_by: actor extraction + entity linking + knowledge-base organisation relations (not built)

speaker_relation.populated_by: speaker entity linking + knowledge base (not built)

remit_match.populated_by: claim topic vs. publisher mandate through a frozen topic-remit map (map not written)

active_at_claim_date.rule: NO => pair is INELIGIBLE and never scored; UNKNOWN/NOT_COMPUTED => scored normally and noted
